# openrouter_providers (Data Source)

Providers DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openrouter_providers" "my_providers" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `datacenters` (List of String) ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 country codes of the provider datacenter locations
- `headquarters` (String) ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 country code of the provider headquarters
- `name` (String) Display name of the provider
- `privacy_policy_url` (String) URL to the provider's privacy policy
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly identifier for the provider
- `status_page_url` (String) URL to the provider's status page
- `terms_of_service_url` (String) URL to the provider's terms of service
